recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit for FHIR-28499. Handle FHIR-53180 separately if and when the broader per-version terminology capabilities change is in scope for application.
issue_request: FHIR-28499 was a Published/Persuasive Vocab change request to add TerminologyCapabilities.codeSystem.content so terminology capabilities identify whether each supported code system is complete, fragmentary, supplemental, or not present. The resolution required a code element with cardinality 1..1 and a required binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/codesystem-content-mode, using the CodeSystem.content definition and description.
initial_application: Commit 1e011219c1eb2738181c75f2f4add7fc85e3e4c8, merged by 82a330c02a8418e77dbe98d50a591cb36c91836f, previously applied FHIR-28499 by adding TerminologyCapabilities.codeSystem.content to source/terminologycapabilities/structuredefinition-TerminologyCapabilities.xml. The current source keeps the element as code, min 1, max 1, summary true, and required-bound to codesystem-content-mode; source/terminology-service.html also lists codeSystem.content in terminology capability expectations.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes terminologycapabilities=TerminologyCapabilities, so the inspected StructureDefinition source is in current build scope. Vocab minutes from 2021-08-11 record the decision to make the element required, and 2022-08-08 minutes record the application detail to use the CodeSystem.content definition and description. Later issue FHIR-53180 asks for additional per-version content support, but it is only Resolved - change required in this default Applied/Published run scope and does not negate the existing seed element.
reconciliation: No source file was changed. The seed request is already represented in the active current source with the requested cardinality, type, and required binding, and the related terminology service narrative is not misleading.
